models.task: D-Fire fine-tuned smoke and flame detection

actions: Send the dated frame and location to the local sanitation or drainage service for inspection; keep clear of traffic, sharp waste and contaminated water.
prevention: Arrange regular waste collection and drain inspections before heavy rain; compare repeat frames to check whether litter returns.

sources.title: Report a blocked drain or flooding

summary.time_context: Archived evidence: these actions apply if similar conditions recur, not as a report of a current emergency.
limitations: Model scores are not calibrated probabilities. Review every finding against the frame.
Open-vocabulary waste masks are proposals, not a site-trained hazard classifier.
CLIPSeg scores are mean pixel activations within a proposed mask; they are not detection probabilities or measured accuracy.
Smoke does not establish wildfire cause or PM2.5. Plain water and ordinary scene objects are not threat detections.
A manually marked drain region plus waste overlap suggests inspection, not confirmed hydraulic blockage.
At most 12 frames are sampled. Clip evidence requires overlapping same-hazard boxes in two distinct samples; this is not calibrated object tracking.
People and vehicles detected by the model are obscured in thumbnails. Review before public sharing.

provenance.capture_mode: bundled dated source; rescan does not make an archive live
